author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Thank you Front Line Gaming for sponsoring this episode.  Matts, terrain, gaming accessories you name it they got it.  Tickets are available for the Las Vegas Open, one of the largest 40k tournaments in the world on October 1st to 4th.  Also this year, Gundam Assemble, KOTC and more are running events.  It's sure to be a blast. 
https://www.lasvegasopen.net

===============GAME INFO=============

Jordan has been looking forward to his chance to play the Sisters of Battle on the channel, and here is that chance!  Nick brings all three of T'au's 1 DP detachments to counter him, with Krootox and battle suits aplenty. 


===============ARMY LIST=============

Advanced Acquisition Cadre, Auxiliary Cadre and Experimental Prototype Cadre (3 Detachment Points)
